title: Pilot G2 Premium Retractable Gel Pens, Fine 0.7mm, Black, 12-Pack (31020)

comparisons.notes: Pilot G2 31020, 0.7mm black, dozen; $14.99 (reg $19.99), delivery by Tue Nov 3, available in store

writeup: The Pilot G2 Premium retractable gel pen 12-pack (model 31020, fine 0.7mm, black ink) is $6.99 at Woot, about 58 cents a pen. G2s are refillable and have a comfort grip and clip. Staples sells the same dozen for $14.99. Limit 5 per customer.
